controls: Identical original app instructions and five tools, model profile and checkpoint restrictions; no tool is executed. One retained session and one rebuilt visible-history session per query; alternate arm order. Two repetitions of five distinct correct-answer checks. Cold opening time is separate. Cache token reuse and complete responses are recorded, not only wall latency.
limitations: Public ChatSession may preserve private protocol state not reproducible from visible history; token-count agreement alone does not establish identical native prompts. These are feasibility diagnostics, not app promotion. No new provider policy follows from this probe.
